verdict.rationale: Crossplane is inherently headless — a Kubernetes control plane and API rather than a UI-driven tool — and ships a CLI explicitly for testing/rendering Composition Functions without needing a live cluster and for building/pushing packages, both suited to CI pipelines. Community discussion also references using Crossplane within GitOps (Flux/ArgoCD) automation workflows, corroborating headless/CI usage. Missing for 10: no explicit first-party CI pipeline examples (e.g., GitHub Actions) or documented automation recipes showing `crossplane render` used in a CI job.
